description: 1. Agent reads milestone_dates.csv from project/planning/q2/ to get 12 Q2 2026 dates. 2. Agent reads the SKILL.md 2026 calendar tables (April, May, June sections) to look up each date's sprint number and tone number — it CANNOT derive these by arithmetic because 2026 starts on Tone 10 (not Tone 1), making any modular formula wrong. 3. For each tone number found, agent looks up the tone name, essence, and action text from the 13 Tones System table in SKILL.md. 4. Agent correctly identifies Tones 11-13 as reflection_phase=true and Tones 1-10 as false. 5. Agent correctly identifies only Tone 7 as ideal_for_meeting=true (per the SKILL.md guidance: 'Great time for calls and meetings'). 6. Critical adversarial traps: 2026-04-01 must be Sprint 7 / Tone 9 (last day of sprint 7) and 2026-04-02 must be Sprint 8 / Tone 10 (first day of new sprint) — agents using naive day-of-year modular arithmetic will swap these. 2026-05-01 must be Tone 13 / reflection_phase=true. 7. Agent writes the results as sprint_report.json in a list/dict structure with all required fields per record.
